# remmynd

> Reminders that make sure it happens. Write a reminder in one line and share the link. Anyone who taps it is reminded in layers (calendar, then notifications) and followed through until it's done. No account needed. Free, no account needed, no tracking. Made by Zoof04 Inc. The code is MIT-licensed.

An assistant can make a remmynd reminder by writing a web address. No account and no API key.

## Make a reminder from a web address

https://remmynd.space/new?t=Demo+day&at=2026-12-05T18:00&tz=Asia/Kolkata&l=https://lu.ma/demo

- `t`: title (required)
- `at`: when, `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm`, optionally with `Z` or an offset like `+05:30` (required)
- `tz`: IANA time zone for `at`, like `Asia/Kolkata`
- `d`: length in minutes (default 60)
- `l`: place or link
- `n`: notes
- `h`: host

With `tz`, or a `Z` or offset in `at`, the address redirects to a shared link (`https://remmynd.space/r/…`) at once. Without one, the time is read in the visitor's own time zone. URL-encode each value.

## Connector (MCP)

Assistants that take MCP connectors (remote MCP servers) can add remmynd at https://remmynd.space/mcp (Streamable HTTP, MCP 2026-07-28 and earlier versions back to 2025-03-26). No account and no key. Tools:

- `make_reminder_link`: title, start (`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm` with an IANA `time_zone`, or an exact time with `Z` or an offset), and optional `duration_minutes`, `location`, `notes`, `host`, `private`
- `make_reminder_from_text`: one line the way a person writes it ("Dentist Tue 4pm"), with the person's `time_zone`
- `read_reminder_link`: what a remmynd link holds

The connector only turns words into a link and a link back into words. It stores and logs nothing.

## Reminder card

An iframe of `https://remmynd.space/embed/<payload>` (the code after `/r/` in a shared link) shows the reminder as a card with a Remind me button. `?theme=light` or `?theme=dark` pins a theme. Private links can't be embedded.

## Links

- Shared links, `https://remmynd.space/r/<payload>`, show the title and time in chat previews. The server reads them only to fill the preview and stores and logs nothing.
- Private links, `https://remmynd.space/#<payload>`, never reach a server.
- The payload is base64url-encoded JSON: `t` title, `s` start (minutes since 1970 UTC, base 36), and optional `d` length, `l` place, `n` notes, `h` host, `z` the host's time zone.

## Docs

- [Docs](https://remmynd.space/docs): the link format, /new, the connector for AI assistants, the npm library, the command line, badges and self-hosting
- [For hosts](https://remmynd.space/hosts): badges, QR codes and chat previews
- [Privacy](https://remmynd.space/privacy): what the server keeps (only an anonymous ping time for phone alerts, deleted once sent)
- [Changelog](https://remmynd.space/changelog)
- [About](https://remmynd.space/about): who makes remmynd and the principles it holds to
- [Open numbers](https://remmynd.space/open): stars, downloads, tests, size budgets and what the server keeps, with how each is checked
- [Blog](https://remmynd.space/blog): what changed and why
- [Source on GitHub](https://github.com/Remmynd/remmynd)
- [npm package](https://www.npmjs.com/package/remmynd): `npm install remmynd`, or `npx remmynd "Demo day" --at "2026-12-05 18:00" --tz Asia/Kolkata`
